# quiv (Knowledge Kit)

> 10–32x token-efficient CLI & architecture system for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Copilot).

## Core Philosophy & Capability Tiers
quiv replaces bloated codebase context dumps with a 5-tier progressive disclosure architecture:
1. `primitives/`: Atomic building blocks (hooks, pure utils, headless UI contracts)
2. `domain/`: Business logic, domain rules, calculation formulas, data schemas
3. `features/`: Complete encapsulated feature units (offline sync, auth queues)
4. `compositions/`: Assembly patterns for specific app categories (Apple PWA, dashboard)
5. `templates/`: Full starter scaffolds

## Essential Context & Documentation Links
- [CLI Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quiv-knowledge/quiv/main/packages/cli/README.md): Commands, options, and progressive disclosure flags.
- [Knowledge Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quiv-knowledge/quiv/main/knowledge/INDEX.md): Up-to-date catalog of all available patterns and their validation status.
- [Conventions & Lore-lite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quiv-knowledge/quiv/main/meta/conventions.md): Commit trailers (Constraint, Rejected, Evidence) and contribution standards.
- [Full Context Bundle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quiv-knowledge/quiv/main/llms-full.txt): Complete API definitions and progressive disclosure guides.

## Primary CLI Commands
```bash
# Discover patterns (200-400 tokens)
quiv list --tier features

# Search patterns semantically (300-500 tokens)
quiv find "offline sync with conflict resolution"

# Read pattern with progressive disclosure (overview: 250t, full: 1000t, implementation: 3000t)
quiv read features/offline-sync --level overview

# Scaffold pattern and dependencies into a target project
quiv use features/offline-sync --dest ./src --project my-app

# Distill and harvest newly built components into QUIV
quiv learn --from ./src/components/MyComponent.tsx --tier compositions --name my-component -m "feat: description" -c "constraints" -r "rejected" -e "evidence"
```
